scope: local SDL UIKit and SDL_video.c focus handling
findings: SDL UIKit clears keyboard state and emits focus loss before the background event; foreground and focus restoration events are drained before the next engine frame.
Engine pauses background rendering and resets frame timing on foreground restoration.
Finger cancellation does not enter the tap branch. The focus-loss cancellation flag survives until the next input frame, which clears pending HUD input, touches and double-tap state.
Pointer locking is recalculated from application activity and window focus; SDL focus handling also updates relative mouse mode.
